blocks.text: ScrollView makes its children scrollable. It is useful for a limited amount of content that can be rendered together.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

blocks.code:
import {ScrollView,Text} from "react-native";
export default function App(){return <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{padding:24}}>{Array.from({length:20},(_,i)=><Text key={i} style={{padding:12}}>Reading tip {i+1}</Text>)}</ScrollView>;}

items: `ScrollView` lays out all its children in a scrollable area, so keep that content bounded.

blocks.text: The tips can scroll if they do not fit on the screen.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: ScrollView renders all its children. Use FlatList for a large or growing list.
